correctness.rationale: Positive entropy mixing SFT has arbitrarily many distinct finite periodic orbits. Finite clopen cylinder partition isolates k selected orbits; locally constant g_t=Σe^{t_i}1_{U_i} is bounded above and below by positive constants. Birkhoff sums along predetermined admissible infinite extensions are linear-growing word quasimorphisms: concat defect bounded by 2(L-1)(M-m), independent of word lengths. Periodic homogenization equals one-period sum exactly because extension boundary error is uniformly bounded. Any periodic length ratio is convex combination of coordinate ratios exp(t_i-s_i), and each extreme is attained by a selected periodic orbit. Thus both dilations give max-minus-min variation metric, injective after common shifts. Four points in k=3 yield pairing sums 3R versus 2R, violating any fixed hyperbolicity delta. Independently checked all periodic binary words up to length 10 for two coordinate weight choices, corroborating rather than replacing the general cylinder proof.
